description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A wide drying frame contains stepped circular cradles for inverted empty bowls. Side: Open slatted bamboo rails slope slightly toward a removable blank drip pan. Rear: The rear support posts reveal wrapped joints and an unobstructed drainage opening. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of this exact rattan/bamboo household object. Create ONE corrected rear catalog photo by camera movement only. The camera faces the OUTSIDE BACK of the tall rectangular cane-lattice backboard. Show the full-height flat mesh backing and rear support posts, drainage opening and back of base. The fifteen semicircular bowl cradles are on the OPPOSITE/front side, mostly hidden behind this rear backboard, not facing viewer. Do not repeat the front cradle mouths in this rear view. Preserve exact original proportions, color, weave, number and location of all supports, compartments, rods, legs and plain secondary inserts. Previously hidden rear geometry is inferred but must plausibly support this exact object without redesign. Whole product centered on same warm-white seamless studio background, soft light and shadow, no props. NO TEXT, labels, logos, numbers or markings.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
